records.occurrenceRemarks: The picture is of a full grown elephant in Ooty, Tamil Nadu, India. It is around 4m tall, has a long truck and is greyish-blackish in color. Elephants are the largest animals on land. They use their trucks for their daily activities like drinking water, bathing, picking up stuffs, etc. They can live up to 70-80 years. Elephants are very intelligent creatures and have an IQ of 2.4.

It's a picture of a young deer, spotted in it's natural habitat in the deer park in ooty, Tamil Nadu, India. The deer is reddish brown in color & it has long & lean legs. The height of the deer is around 85cm and it weights around 80-90 pounds. Axis deer are one of the most common deer found in India. They usually stay in a group and feed on grasses & flowers. They prefer slightly cooler environment & drink a lot of water during summer, as they can often be spotted near water bodies. Axis deer are important contributors to eco-system. Deforestation causes a threat to their existence.
